title: Otori Emu — Fishing Before The Storm〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Backstage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you all ready to rehearse?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After we got off that island, we've been scrambling to practice and get ready, but we finally made it to this point.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and Robo-Nene was also able to receive some much-needed maintenance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank goodness you got looked at before you got all rusty, Robo-Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes. I was afraid that I'd have to change my name to “Robo-Nene the Rust Bucket”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. We wouldn't want that to happen, now would we?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. We like you the way you are, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, everyone! I know we usually don't, but we're going to give this rehearsal everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, we get it.
There's no point in rehearsing unless we treat it like the real thing, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Precisely!
Anyway, we're on standby!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, I'm gonna move over there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke! Wait, Keisuke, you're here too?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Ah, there you are.
How's your rehearsal going?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're just about to get started☆
I'll be appearing from over here♪

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't know you were coming to Okinawa too, Keisuke!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Oh, I rushed over as soon as I received word that you all became stranded...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But I'm glad to see that you're neither hurt nor ill.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I'm so full of energy that I can't stay still☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, I really can't wait to show you our show♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see. As usual, you seem to be in as good a mood as ever.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Wait, where did that come from...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I was just describing what I saw.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Oh, um... Okay...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Anyway, since your rehearsal's about to start, we should probably move somewhere else.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We're leaving the show in your troupe's hands, Emu. Give it everything you have as per normal.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We will! We're gonna do our best to make sure the audience smiles from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke's Voice
rows.Line: So, about what we were discussing... Everything that happened during this voyage was all my fault...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I wish I'd checked the weather forecast more closely and learned more about the surrounding islands beforehand...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I was far too hasty with my preparations and wasn't able to deal with the inclement weather as a result. And I ended up putting everybody's lives in danger...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I have no excuse for what happened this time around. I'm prepared to take full responsibility for what happened.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Take responsibility...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But he's an adult... And the managing director... Even if I tried to say something, he'll probably just...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot!
Keisuke, Shosuke, listen♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Huh? You're still here...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe! There's something I forgot to tell you, Keisuke!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆ Guess what? We got to do some fishing when we were aboard the cruiser! And then, I felt something really big get caught on my line!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I tried to reel it in, but it wouldn't budge at all! That was when I had Tsukasa help me out...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And it turned out that we were trying to reel in the Earth☆

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Emu...
Should you be getting ready to rehearse instead of telling us that story...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
We decided to have some sandwiches for lunch and all these seagulls started flying towards us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, Robo-Nene used her angry eyes to scare them off and we got to eat our sandwiches in peace!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
After that, Rui got really seasick...
I think it was because he was reading the whole time, but we all did our best to make him feel better!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, we all had a lot of fun on the cruiser!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And Shosuke worked really, really hard to fix the radio while we were on that desert island! That's why we were able to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wah! Shosuke, my hair's gonna be a mess...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Quiet, you. I know you'll have time to fix it before you go on stage. Also, what's a kid like you doing trying to cover for an adult?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Emu, did you have fun during this trip?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup...! It was super duper extra fun!
I'm sure Tsukasa and the others will say the same!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Hey, Emu!
The rehearsal's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sorry, I've gotta get going!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We'll have a chance to discuss all this later, but at the very least, you all seem to have enjoyed yourselves very much...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I'm glad for you, Shosuke.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Me too...
